source: maplestory.io (GMS 270) — skillbook API + raw WZ API; class-specific 5th job skill list cross-checked against maplestorywiki.net
notes: One-Punch Man collab class; single job file 12200; no 5th-job V skills in scope.

skills.name: Hero from Another World
skills.description: Increases all stats by a set percentage.

skills.name: Physical Training I
skills.description: Basic physical ability attained through training.

skills.name: Physical Training II
skills.description: Enhanced physical ability attained through consistent training.

skills.name: Physical Training III
skills.description: Further enhanced physical ability attained through in-depth training.

skills.name: Physical Training IV
skills.description: The limit of physical ability attained through intense training.

skills.name: Double Jump
skills.description: Leap forward once while already in the air. Press the up key at the same time to move upward.

skills.name: Normal Punch
skills.description: Deliver a normal punch to enemies in front of Saitama.

skills.name: Consecutive Normal Punches
skills.description:
Attack enemies in front of Saitama with consecutive normal punches made with one hand.\r
Immune to knockback and debilitating status conditions while using the skill.

skills.name: Run
skills.description:
Quickly run forward.\r
Press the arrow keys while running to move in 8 directions.

skills.name: Vertical Jump
skills.description: Jump incredibly high into the air.

skills.name: Killer Move: Serious Series - Serious Sideways Jumps
skills.description:
Repeatedly jump at high speeds to leave afterimages behind.
Your are invincible while using Killer Move: Serious Series - Serious Sideways Jumps.

skills.name: Killer Move: Serious Series - Serious Punch
skills.description:
Saitama unleashes the Killer Move: Serious Series - Serious Punch.\r
Killer Move: Serious Series - Serious Punch is unaffected by attack reflection.

skills.name: Killer Move: Serious Series - Serious Punch
Killer Move: Serious Series - Serious Punch
Incineration Cannon
skills.description: Genos appears and fires the incineration cannon forward. Incineration Cannon is unaffected by attack reflection.

skills.name: King Engine
skills.description: King appears and revs up the King Engine. Enemies near King tremble in fear and take damage. King Engine is unaffected by attack reflection.

skills.name: Hellstorm
skills.description: Hellish Blizzard appears and creates a storm that attacks the boss with the highest HP within range first. Hellstorm is unaffected by attack reflection.

skills.name: Psychic Powers
skills.description: Terrible Tornado appears and uses her psychic powers to throw battlefield debris at enemies. Attacks enemies with the highest HP within range first, and is unaffected by attack reflection.

skills.name: Hero Pride
skills.description: Hone your resolve to ignore certain abnormal statuses. Immune to abnormal statuses for 3 seconds sec. Only prevents certain abnormal statuses. Hero Pride can be used while using other skills.
